text:
Predicates:
Timeless(x) ::: x is a timeless design.
MassProduct(x) ::: x is a mass product design.
DesignBy(x, y) ::: x is a design by y.
Evocative(x) ::: x is an evocative design.
Dreamy(x) ::: x is a dreamy design.
Premises:
∀x (DesignBy(x, zaha) → Timeless(x)) ::: All of Zaha Hadid's design styles are timeless.
∀x (MassProduct(x) → ¬Timeless(x)) ::: No mass product design is timeless.
∃x (DesignBy(x, zaha) ∨ DesignBy(x, kelly)) ::: Either Zaha Hadid's design style or Kelly Wearstler's design style.
∀x (DesignBy(x, kelly) → Evocative(x)) ::: All of Kelly Wearstler's design styles are evocative.
∀x (DesignBy(x, kelly) → Dreamy(x)) ::: All of Kelly Wearstler's design styles are dreamy.
∀x (DesignBy(x, max) ∧ Timeless(x) → MassProduct(x) ∧ Evocative(x)) ::: If a design by Max is timeless, then a design by Max is a mass product design and evocative.
Conclusion:
∀x (DesignBy(x, max) → Evocative(x) ∨ Dreamy(x)) ::: A design by Max is either evocative or dreamy.
